items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Just certain boys who had a gift for business would hire Tulane Jim and hire the band... I was a little bit too young then around 17 or 18 to to know whether they made money or not

ctx.x: Can you tell us any more about these Saturday night dances? Were they something that fraternities would put on or who?
Oh, no, no. Just certain boys who had a gift for business would hire Tulane Jim and hire the band and charge everybody a dollar to get in. And I guess they made money.
at it I was a little bit too young then around 17 or 18 to to know whether they made money or not the thing that interested me was the pretty girls and and the band that was enough for me
